headline: Warbound bank deposits now warn before ending refunds, Warbank options are in the menu and settings, and Sort Bank only sorts.

entries.title: Deposit All Warbound Items in the bank menu
entries.details: The bank's left-click menu in the classic bag design now includes Deposit All Warbound Items when a Warbank is available. The bank menu button's Shift right-click tooltip now names this action as well.

entries.title: Include Tradeable Reagents setting for Warbank
entries.details: Added an Include Tradeable Reagents toggle on the Bank settings page under a new Warbank section on the General tab, and in the classic bag design's bank menu, when a Warbank is available.

entries.title: Sort Bank no longer deposits reagents automatically
entries.details: Sorting your bank now only sorts items instead of silently depositing all reagents into your character bank first.

entries.title: Warbound deposit asks before ending item refunds
entries.details: Depositing all warbound items now checks your bags for refundable items and asks for confirmation before removing their refund timers, instead of ending refunds silently.
